title: Maximize Sum of Device Ratings
summary: Each device starts with n units and its rating is its minimum unit capacity, or zero if empty. Any device can be chosen as a source at most once, removing exactly one of its then-current units and transferring it to another device. Receiving units is unrestricted and does not use the source allowance. Maximize the sum of final device ratings.
officialConstraints: 1..100000 devices and initial units per device; total initial units <=200000; capacities 1..100000.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
